ui.welcome_1: Pick a tree to start chopping. Higher levels unlock better trees, and each tree has its own mastery to 99.
ui.welcome_2: The game keeps going while the page is closed, for up to {cap}.
ui.welcome_3: Playtesting? Tap Flag at the top whenever something feels slow, fast or fun. Settings has Send playtest file.
ui.about_construction: Saw planks from logs, then build carts for the Trader, frames for the Inventor and rooms for your estate. Construction opens with the Trader.
ui.about_trader: Fill towns' orders and send caravans of your goods. Caravans bring back spices for Cooking, dye for Crafting and glass for lenses. Prices move in a cycle you can see ahead.
ui.about_estate: Rise from commoner to duke by paying gold, building rooms and proving yourself. Rooms make skills better, servants work alongside you, and the estate pays by the hour.
ui.about_workshop: Take apart things you made for parts, research blueprints, and build gadgets for your tools and machines that work alongside you. Build an invention again to improve it.
ui.about_observatory: Six signs rise in turn. Training a skill under its sign gathers starlight; meditate with it, and with runes, for Attunement. Its rewards are time: a longer away limit, astral runes and faster crops.
ui.needs_room_workshop: The workshop is a room in your estate. Build it there to open the Inventor.
ui.needs_room_observatory: The observatory is a room in your estate. Build it there to open the sky.

ui.regions_intro: The world opens in five regions. Each adds new trees, rocks, fish and crops, new things to make, its own enemies, champions, recipes and towns, a dungeon, and a new tier of every engine. A region opens at a total level and closes again when you prestige. The Beyond opens only once the Cult has opened the veil, and prestige closes the veil again.

ui.about_stage: Spend renown on Fame ranks, book shows at venues, and gain up to three followers who gather for you.
ui.stage_intro: Each Fame rank above the first makes towns pay {pct}% more for orders and the estate pay {pct}% more income. Your first {n} ranks in the Vale each bring a follower.

ui.weapons_intro: Each weapon has its own level, shared by every weapon of that name. The weapon in hand learns from its hits; its style gets half of what it learns. Every {hit} levels add 1 max hit and every {land} add 1% to land. A stronger weapon learns at full speed once the style's weaker weapons add up to its tier × {per} levels, and never slower than {min}%.

ui.about_cult: Start a cult. Convert cultists with renown or the estate's gold, write and find teachings, and link them into a regime; the cultists read it and cast its rites while you do other things.
ui.cult_intro: Link teachings into groups on the graph. A group that holds every teaching a rite needs casts it: your cultists cast every rite the graph holds each cycle. More cultists make the cycle faster and the rites surer; so does devotion, which grows with each rite that lands.

Each region has two books: a common one that turns up now and then from any work or fight there, and a rare one from its dungeon chests and champions. Insight decodes the Observatory's star patterns into sky maps and researches the tomes the Cult's rites turn up.

ui.about_exploration: Send a party of followers, knights, servants and cultists on expeditions to old manors, crypts and stranger places. They answer offerings, pass checks and fight, and bring back things found nowhere else.
ui.explore_intro: Choose a site, pick a party and give each member gear, food and runes, then send them. Members away do no other work. A beaten member comes home and rests. An expedition fails if an offering's time runs out or everyone is beaten: the site starts over, you keep what was found, and everyone sent rests.
ui.site_sub: {region} · Exploration {lvl} · {n} events · cleared {clears} times · {got} of {all} finds
ui.sites_more: {n} more sites to find. Their maps turn up now and then while you read in Lore, in dungeon chests, and rarely while you make runes.

ui.event_check_level: A check: is anyone in the party level {n}? If not, the party works it out in {t}

ui.party_nobody: No one can go yet. Followers come with Fame, servants and knights with the Estate, and bands with the Cult.

ui.explore_kinds: Followers can reach level {f}, knights {k}, servants {s} and bands of cultists {c}. Each grows from the expeditions they come home from. A beaten member rests for {rest}.
ui.gear_about: Gear adds a set amount by its tier. Food heals a member below half health in a fight. Runes add to every swing while they last. Gear and what is left come home.
ui.expedition_travel: On the way to the next event
ui.expedition_home_about: Calling the party home ends the expedition: the site starts over and you keep what was found. No one rests.
ui.knights_about: A knight goes on expeditions, starts at level {lvl} and can reach {top}. Each takes {wage} gold every hour; one unpaid stays home. Your rank in the Vale sets how many you can have.
ui.plan_send_sub: Sends the party planned on the Exploration tab, when no expedition is out
ui.plan_answer_sub: Gives what the offering asks, if you hold it
